description.value: Simon's Bike Shop is an independent bicycle retailer situated in Library Square in downtown Vancouver, carrying a broad range of bikes from road and gravel to mountain and e-bikes, with a particularly strong Specialized lineup. Professionally trained technicians handle everything from quick adjustments to full drivetrain overhauls, making it a dependable stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical support before or during a trip. A rentals program and comprehensive parts and accessories inventory — including e-bike batteries and components — add further utility for visitors.
